AI Overview
Time Shooter 3: SWAT is a free browser-based 3D first-person shooter developed by GoGoMan, combining the time-control mechanics of SuperHot with a SWAT hostage-rescue theme. 
Core Gameplay Mechanics
Time Manipulation: Time moves only when your character moves; standing still freezes bullets, enemies, and flying objects in place. 
Objectives: Free innocent blue hostages while eliminating armored, helmeted orange terrorists. 
Health & Lives: You have three lives per level tracked by green shields; hitting a hostage results in instant defeat. 
Weapons & Gear: Use pistols, assault rifles, shotguns, machine guns, riot shields, battering rams for purple doors, and explosive pink gas cylinders. 
Controls: Move with WASD or arrow keys, aim and shoot with the mouse, throw weapons or shields with right-click or R, and interact with riot shields using F.
